# PROCESS — cand_0009 (parent = champion cand_0001, val 0.634)

Capability = the spreadsheet agent's system prompt (`prompt.md`). Reader = azure/gpt-5.5 (strong).
Only `prompt.md` is editable. This iteration ships ONE tight, additive, bounded edit
(formula-fidelity) plus its checklist point, after a fresh 2-subagent diagnosis of ALL 40
non-passing traces.

## Noise floor (governs the accept decision — read first)
Two prior "no-op" iterations that were BYTE-IDENTICAL to the champion still scored differently:
cand_0005 = 0.612 (broke {267-18,430-43,58484}, fixed {139-16,35747}) and cand_0008 = 0.656
(broke {347-49,58484}, fixed {139-16,18137,31420,35747,53062}). So run-to-run variance is ±0.022
(±~2 tasks), and tasks {267-18, 347-49, 430-43, 58484, 139-16, 35747, 31420, 53062, 18137} flip
on NOISE, not on any edit. Consequence: a prose lever whose TRUE deterministic signal is < ~4
tasks cannot reliably clear the significance bar — which is exactly why cand_0006 (+0.022, 7 fixed)
and cand_0008 (+0.022) were both gate-REJECTED.

## Ranked clusters this iteration (fresh diagnosis; leverage = #tasks × recoverable)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 2 | sample under-specifies the op (flaky, [1,0,0]) | 30930, 32975, 42930, 55912, 58890, 35747, 50526, 53957, 139-16 | sample never exercises the ambiguous case (boundary inclusivity, tie, dup key, the boundary row itself, label spelling) → passes case 1, fails 2/3 | (per-task/ambiguous) | SKIP — sample genuinely under-determines; fails VERIFIED |
| 3 | formula quoted/present but paraphrased | 6698 (0/3), 45944 (0/3), 50755 (0/3), 39946 (0/3), 10281 (0/3) | agent trusts a looser natural-language paraphrase over the exact formula the instruction quotes or the sheet supplies | KNOWLEDGE | **FIXED — one additive bullet** |
| — | output-token representation | 50486 (Chep vs CHEP), 45944 (TRUE/FALSE vs 1/0), 55258 (int vs float) | casing/type of the emitted label | — | SKIP — unverifiable expected form; overlaps REFUTED casing rule (4225/10281) |

## The one edit shipped (KNOWLEDGE / missing-rule; system-prompt skill lever #4)
New bullet after the anti-hardcode line + checklist point (4):
**"When the instruction QUOTES an Excel formula, or the worksheet holds a reference/worked
formula, that formula is the AUTHORITATIVE spec — follow its exact operators/comparisons/
constants/per-row refs and exact output text-casing, not a looser natural-language paraphrase;
compute what it evaluates to and store the value. Reading a supplied formula is spec-reading,
not hardcoding."**

Why this is a genuinely NEW scope (not a re-ship of the REFUTED reference-formula lever):
cand_0006/cand_0007 scoped their rule to formulas sitting in *cells* (and cand_0006 leaked into
copying example-ANSWER cells → broke 58484/267-18). This edit's decisive addition is the
**precedence rule**: when an instruction contains BOTH a prose description AND the literal
formula, the formula wins. That case (6698, 45944) was never addressed. It references *formulas*,
never example-answer values, so it carries none of cand_0006's copy leak.

## Verify-the-fix (trace evidence → behavior change)
- 6698: instruction literally quotes `SUM(COUNTIFS('raw 1'!B2:B100000,{">",">","="}&0,'raw 1'!C2:C100000,{"<","=","<"}&0))`. Agent wrote a paraphrase that counts "B≠0 OR C≠0" — but the array COUNTIFS counts only 3 sign combos (B>0&C<0, B>0&C=0, B=0&C<0), so it OVER-counts → 0/3. Edit makes the quoted formula authoritative → agent replicates the array logic + adds the A==F condition → matches. VERIFIED against the quoted formula.
- 50755: answer cells hold literal per-row difference formulas `=D2-D4`/`=F1-F3` (prior traces, JOURNAL cand_0007). Reproducing that exact per-row method (vs a look-alike) is the fix; this was the ONE task the reference-formula lever fixed deterministically across cand_0006 AND cand_0007 (never fixed by a no-op).
- 39946: reference formula uses `/365`; agent used a different denominator. 10281: col-I `IF(...,"PASS","FAIL")` defines the exact casing.

## Blast-radius / SAFE check
- Class = tasks where a formula is quoted or present. Passing formula tasks (2212, 31420, 32255, 35747, 37962, 49237, 54675, 53023, 45581, CF_7349, …) already reproduce their formula's result correctly (they pass 3/3) → the rule REINFORCES what they do = no-op. Tasks with NO formula → activation condition false → no-op. BOUNDED additive.
- Casing clause is scoped to "as shown in the reference formula/worked example," NOT the REFUTED "match the sheet-header casing" rule (4225 has no formula → unaffected; its GT casing contradicts the instruction and is left alone).
- Avoided every LEDGER-refuted lever: type-coercion (cand_0002 broke 430-43/61-4/58484/47699), read-scope/#N/A/deletion-fill (cand_0003 broke 7), write-value-on-format (cand_0004 broke 267-18/347-49/430-43/47699/58484).

## Honest expectation
Best-case deterministic target is ~4-5 tasks (6698, 45944, 50755, 39946, 10281); realistic
deterministic signal is likely ~2-3, which is near/under the ±0.022 noise floor — so ACCEPT is
NOT assured and may be gate-rejected on significance like cand_0006/0007. It is shipped anyway
because (a) rejection reverts with ZERO downside (champion preserved), (b) it is the strongest
REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED lever available, and (c) a 4th pure no-op adds nothing. The formula-fidelity
family is the only lever ever shown to fix a 0/3 task deterministically (50755).

## Process & features used
- 2 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents diagnosed all 25 always-fail + 15 flaky traces
  (code vs preview/feedback). Both converged with the 3 prior diagnoses: residual is per-task
  logic + sample-underspecification; candidate levers (casing, type-preservation, read-scope) all
  map onto REFUTED rules. The instruction-quoted-formula precedence gap is the only new, safe,
  verifiable angle they surfaced.
- Ground-truth answer files are NOT on disk; diagnosis used generated code + preview + feedback.

## Deliberately skipped
- Cluster 1 (per-task logic, ~19 tasks): only overfit per-task examples fix them → held-out gate rejects.
- Cluster 2 (sample under-specifies): even a human can't know the boundary/tie rule from case-1 data → fails VERIFIED.
- casing / type-preservation / read-scope: each maps onto a LEDGER-refuted lever (regressed passers).
- ENV faults 34-5, 32023: clock-relative; not prose-fixable. HUMAN ACTION: pin the sandbox clock or exclude time-relative tasks.
